blue.name: THE HUMAN
stats: SECRET WEAPON: TURNING IT OFF AND ON

vo.l01: Tonight... flesh versus metal. Humanity's last stand.
vo.l02: In the red corner... the robot! Eight hundred kilos of steel. It never sleeps, never sweats, and it has read every boxing book ever written.
vo.l03: And in the blue corner... the human! Runs on coffee and spite, and has never once read the manual.
vo.l04: Fun fact: that robot calculates a million punches per second.
vo.l05: Ohh! Error four-oh-four: mercy not found.
vo.l06: But humans have something robots never had... pure chaos.
vo.l11: Somewhere, a toaster just filed a complaint. Humans one, machines zero... for now.

caption: Humanity vs. the machine 🤖🥊 Who should fight next? 👇
